title: I'm Investing $20,000 Into These 2 Stocks
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: Mark Roussin CPA says he is putting nearly $20,000 to work in two long-term growth stocks, but he is not buying either at market — instead he is selling December 18 cash-secured puts to get paid to wait for his entry prices, targeting over $1,200 in combined premium on about $19,500 of backing cash. For Rocket Lab he likes the integrated space business beyond Electron launch — space systems, spacecraft components and satellite systems — with Q2 revenue of about $234 million up roughly 62% and a $2.4 billion backlog, while flagging that the Neutron rocket's first launch has been delayed to 2027 and the name remains speculative. For Credo Technology he focuses on high-speed connectivity and active electrical cables for AI data centres, with fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of about $480 million up roughly 115%, 68% non-GAAP gross margin and full-year guidance for over 85% growth, balanced against concentration risk — its top four customers are about 84% of revenue — and he already owns shares. Calls made: RKLB — CONDITIONAL_BUY, entry only via the Dec 18 $45 put at about $2.40 premium (effective basis $42.60), first tracked call; CRDO — CONDITIONAL_BUY, entry only via the Dec 18 $150 put at about $9.90 premium (effective basis $140.10), a soft flip from BUY on 2026-10-13 back to his 8 Oct put stance.

calls.price_at_call: entry via Dec 18 $45 cash-secured put (~$2.40 premium; effective basis $42.60)
calls.thesis: First tracked Mark RKLB call: long-term bullish on the space economy but will not buy at market — exposure only if assigned at $45. Electron launch + space-systems business growing (Q2 rev $234M +62%, $2.4B backlog), but Neutron first launch delayed to 2027.
calls.bull_case: Integrated space infrastructure beyond just launch; backlog and revenue momentum show a real business under the rocket story.
calls.bear_case: Neutron delays (and possible further slips) push costs out and profitability further into the future; speculative, execution risk.

calls.stance_flip: soft downgrade: was BUY on 2026-10-13, now CONDITIONAL_BUY
calls.price_at_call: entry via Dec 18 $150 cash-secured put (~$9.90 premium; effective basis $140.10)
calls.thesis: Soft flip back to his 10-08 stance: bullish long-term on AI connectivity (AECs) and will gladly add at $150, but no longer buying outright — only via assignment. Q1 FY27 rev $480M +115%, 68% non-GAAP gross margin, FY27 guide >85%; already owns shares.
calls.bull_case: AI data-center buildout keeps demand for high-speed, power-efficient connectivity growing; already showing in financials.
calls.bear_case: Top 4 customers = 84% of revenue; concentration plus fast growth expectations mean sharp volatility.
